roles_confirmation_note.id: Tujuh peran IT di atas sudah mencukupi kebutuhan MVP bagi mahasiswa tingkat akhir, lulusan baru, dan kandidat awal karier di Indonesia tanpa menambah peran baru.
roles_confirmation_note.en: These seven IT roles cover the MVP scope for Indonesian final-year students, fresh graduates, and early-career candidates without adding extra roles.

id.label: Umum dan perkenalan diri
id.description: Pertanyaan pembuka tentang latar belakang Anda, alasan memilih bidang IT, gaya kerja tim, dan tujuan karier.
id.best_for: Pemanasan sebelum wawancara atau wawancara awal bersama HR.

en.label: General & introduction
en.description: Opening questions about your background, motivation for working in IT, teamwork habits, and career goals.
en.best_for: Warming up or preparing for an initial HR screening call.

id.label: Perilaku (STAR)
id.description: Pertanyaan tentang pengalaman nyata saat bekerja dalam tim, menghadapi tenggat waktu, atau menyelesaikan masalah dengan alur Situasi, Tugas, Aksi, dan Hasil.
id.best_for: Melatih cerita pengalaman kuliah, magang, atau kerja agar runtut dan punya hasil yang jelas.

en.label: Behavioral (STAR)
en.description: Experience-based questions on teamwork, tight deadlines, mistakes, and problem-solving using Situation, Task, Action, and Result.
en.best_for: Structuring real project or campus stories clearly with concrete outcomes.

id.label: Teknis sesuai peran
id.description: Pertanyaan praktik kerja dan pengambilan keputusan teknis yang disesuaikan dengan peran IT yang Anda pilih.
id.best_for: Persiapan wawancara user atau diskusi teknis bersama engineer dan desainer.

en.label: Role-specific technical
en.description: Practical engineering, testing, data, or design questions tailored to the IT role you selected.
en.best_for: Preparing for technical user interviews and day-to-day problem-solving discussions.

id.label: Backend developer
id.description: Membangun layanan server, alur data, autentikasi, dan basis data yang menopang aplikasi di balik layar.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang terbiasa membuat API, mengelola database, atau menjaga keamanan dan kecepatan server.

en.label: Backend developer
en.description: Builds the server logic, APIs, databases, and security rules that power an application behind the scenes.
en.best_for: Candidates focused on server-side code, databases, authentication, and reliability.

id.label: Frontend developer
id.description: Membangun tampilan situs atau aplikasi web yang cepat, responsif, dan nyaman dipakai di browser.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang suka mengubah desain menjadi halaman web interaktif dan rapi di desktop maupun ponsel.

en.label: Frontend developer
en.description: Builds fast, responsive, and accessible web interfaces that users interact with directly in the browser.
en.best_for: Candidates focused on web UI components, state handling, and browser performance.

id.label: Fullstack developer
id.description: Mengerjakan fitur secara utuh dari tampilan antarmuka pengguna hingga layanan API dan penyimpanan data di server.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang nyaman menghubungkan halaman web dengan backend dan database sekaligus.

en.label: Fullstack developer
en.description: Builds features end to end, connecting user interfaces on the browser with backend APIs and databases.
en.best_for: Candidates comfortable working across both frontend screens and backend data flows.

id.label: Mobile developer
id.description: Membuat aplikasi Android atau iOS yang lancar dipakai di ponsel dengan koneksi stabil maupun terbatas.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang berfokus pada pengembangan aplikasi ponsel, izin perangkat, dan pengalaman layar sentuh.

en.label: Mobile developer
en.description: Builds Android or iOS apps that stay smooth across device sizes, permissions, and uneven mobile networks.
en.best_for: Candidates focused on native or cross-platform mobile apps and app store releases.

id.label: QA engineer
id.description: Memastikan fitur berjalan sesuai kebutuhan dengan merancang skenario uji, mencari celah bug, dan menjaga mutu sebelum rilis.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang teliti menguji alur pengguna, API, dan pencegahan error sebelum aplikasi dirilis.

en.label: QA engineer
en.description: Protects product quality by designing test cases, spotting edge-case bugs, and verifying fixes before release.
en.best_for: Candidates focused on manual testing, test automation, and API or release quality checks.

id.label: Data / AI engineer
id.description: Menyiapkan data yang bersih, menganalisis pola, serta membangun dan mengevaluasi model AI agar berguna bagi pengguna.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang bekerja dengan pengolahan data, pipeline ETL, machine learning, atau fitur berbasis AI.

en.label: Data / AI engineer
en.description: Cleans and organizes data, builds reliable pipelines, and trains or evaluates machine learning and AI features.
en.best_for: Candidates focused on analytics, data engineering, ML evaluation, or LLM applications.

id.label: UI/UX designer
id.description: Meriset kebutuhan pengguna, menyusun alur layar yang mudah dipahami, dan merancang tampilan antarmuka di Figma.
id.best_for: Kandidat yang berfokus pada riset pengguna, wireframe, prototipe, aksesibilitas, dan kolaborasi desain ke tim dev.

en.label: UI/UX designer
en.description: Researches user needs, structures clear flows, and designs accessible, consistent interfaces and prototypes.
en.best_for: Candidates focused on user research, wireframing, usability testing, and design systems.

id.label: Teknis Backend developer
id.description: Membahas perancangan API, pemilihan database, kueri lambat, keamanan akun pengguna, caching, dan penanganan error di server.
id.best_for: Latihan menjelaskan keputusan arsitektur server dan pemecahan masalah produksi secara runtut.

en.label: Backend technical track
en.description: Covers API design, SQL vs NoSQL choices, slow database queries, authentication, caching, and server reliability.
en.best_for: Practising clear explanations of server architecture and production debugging.

id.label: Teknis Frontend developer
id.description: Membahas tampilan responsif, kecepatan halaman, pengelolaan state, aksesibilitas, keamanan form, dan kolaborasi dengan desain.
id.best_for: Latihan menjelaskan cara menjaga antarmuka web tetap cepat, rapi, dan nyaman dipakai.

en.label: Frontend technical track
en.description: Covers responsive layouts, rendering speed, state management, accessibility, form safety, and design implementation.
en.best_for: Practising clear explanations of UI engineering and browser performance.

id.label: Teknis Fullstack developer
id.description: Menggabungkan tampilan browser, desain API, database, keselarasan data antara layar dan server, serta penanganan sesi login.
id.best_for: Latihan menjelaskan bagaimana antarmuka, backend, dan database bekerja bersama dalam satu fitur.

en.label: Fullstack technical track
en.description: Combines browser screens, API design, database queries, shared data checks, and sign-in flows.
en.best_for: Practising how to explain full feature ownership from UI to database.

id.label: Teknis Mobile developer
id.description: Membahas siklus hidup layar ponsel, kondisi jaringan terputus, keamanan penyimpanan lokal, izin perangkat, dan rilis aplikasi.
id.best_for: Latihan menjawab kendala nyata di perangkat Android maupun iOS.

en.label: Mobile technical track
en.description: Covers screen lifecycles, offline handling, secure local storage, device permissions, scrolling speed, and app releases.
en.best_for: Practising practical Android and iOS engineering scenarios.

id.label: Teknis QA engineer
id.description: Membahas penyusunan skenario uji, laporan bug yang mudah diulang, pengujian API, tes otomatis, dan pencegahan bug berulang.
id.best_for: Latihan menjelaskan cara menjaga kualitas rilis saat jadwal sempit.

en.label: QA technical track
en.description: Covers test planning, reproducible bug reports, API edge-case checks, test automation strategy, and regression prevention.
en.best_for: Practising how to defend quality priorities under tight release schedules.

id.label: Teknis Data / AI engineer
id.description: Membahas pembersihan data, alur olah data yang andal, ukuran keberhasilan model, pencegahan bocornya data uji, serta pengujian fitur AI.
id.best_for: Latihan menjelaskan alur kerja data dan AI secara sederhana tanpa terjebak istilah rumit.

en.label: Data / AI technical track
en.description: Covers raw data checks, reliable pipelines, accuracy on unseen data, preventing test leakage, and AI output quality.
en.best_for: Practising clear explanations of data quality and real-world AI evaluation.

id.label: Teknis UI/UX designer
id.description: Membahas proses riset hingga prototipe, pengujian ke pengguna, alur informasi, design system, aksesibilitas, dan serah terima ke developer.
id.best_for: Latihan menceritakan alasan di balik keputusan desain dan cara berkolaborasi dengan tim produk.

en.label: UI/UX technical track
en.description: Covers user research to prototyping, usability testing, information architecture, edge states, accessibility, and dev handoff.
en.best_for: Practising how to explain design trade-offs and cross-team collaboration.

id.label: Latihan cepat: perkenalkan diri
id.description: Sesi singkat berisi satu pertanyaan pembuka (Perkenalkan diri Anda) agar Anda bisa langsung mencoba kamera, mikrofon, dan laporan tanpa mengatur set pertanyaan.
id.best_for: Coba pertama kali atau pemanasan singkat kurang dari tiga menit.

en.label: Quick start: introduce yourself
en.description: A one-question session (Introduce yourself and your educational background) to test your setup and get a quick report without configuring a full set.
en.best_for: First-time walkthroughs or a quick warm-up in under three minutes.

id.label: Magang
id.description: Untuk mahasiswa yang melamar program magang dengan proyek kuliah, organisasi, atau studi mandiri.
id.best_for: Latihan magang pertama atau program kampus.

en.label: Internship
en.description: For students applying to internships using coursework, student projects, or independent builds.
en.best_for: First internship applications and campus hiring.

id.label: Fresh graduate
id.description: Untuk lulusan baru atau mahasiswa tingkat akhir yang bersiap masuk peran penuh waktu pertama.
id.best_for: Pencari kerja lulusan baru dengan pengalaman tugas akhir atau magang.

en.label: Fresh graduate
en.description: For recent graduates or final-year students preparing for their first full-time role.
en.best_for: Entry-level full-time interviews after graduation.

id.label: Junior (1 sampai 3 tahun)
id.description: Untuk kandidat dengan pengalaman kerja 1 hingga 3 tahun dalam pengiriman fitur dan kerja tim.
id.best_for: Memperkuat cerita dampak proyek dan keandalan teknis sehari-hari.

en.label: Junior (1 to 3 years)
en.description: For candidates with 1 to 3 years of work experience shipping features in a team.
en.best_for: Sharpening project impact stories and day-to-day technical judgment.

id.label: Menengah (3 tahun atau lebih)
id.description: Untuk praktisi berpengalaman yang mengambil keputusan teknis lintas tim dan menjaga skala sistem.
id.best_for: Latihan menjelaskan trade-off arsitektur, kepemilikan, dan pembimbingan tim.

en.label: Mid-level (3+ years)
en.description: For experienced practitioners handling technical trade-offs, system scale, and team mentoring.
en.best_for: Practising architecture decisions, ownership, and cross-team alignment.
